updateCadence: Tracks Chromium stable closely (three builds Sep 30 - Oct 8, 2026)
summary: Security-hardened Chromium build that is GrapheneOS's default browser and system WebView. Strict site isolation, JIT off by default with per-site toggle, no extensions. Not officially available outside GrapheneOS.
bestFor: People who value exploit mitigation over features
Users who want the safest Chromium on Android
notFor: People who want sync or heavy customization

pros.title: Strict site isolation
pros.detail: Enabled by default per Privacy Ranker comparison.

pros.title: JIT off by default
pros.detail: Per-site toggle reduces JIT exploit surface.

pros.title: Fast Chromium updates
pros.detail: Releases follow Chromium stable within days.

pros.title: System WebView
pros.detail: Hardens every app that uses WebView on GrapheneOS.

pros.title: No telemetry accounts
pros.detail: No sync account or vendor data collection.

cons.title: GrapheneOS only
cons.detail: Cannot supply WebView or full hardening on other Android builds.

cons.title: No extensions
cons.detail: No add-ons, so no ad blocker beyond defaults.

cons.title: Slower JS
cons.detail: JIT disabled by default costs JavaScript speed.

cons.title: Minimal features
cons.detail: No sync, reader mode or customization.

faq.q: Can I install Vanadium on stock Android?
faq.a: Not officially; it depends on GrapheneOS hardening and WebView integration.
Through the GrapheneOS app repository and in OS releases.

timeline.event: Three Chromium bumps between Sep 30 and Oct 8 (Privacy Ranker)

spec.sandbox: Chromium sandbox + strict site isolation + GrapheneOS hardened malloc + MTE on supported Pixels

jsSpeed: JIT off by default trades speed for security
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
privacyDefaults: No telemetry; no blocker or fingerprint work
securityHardening: Strict isolation, JIT off, MTE, hardened malloc
advancedSettings: Few settings; hardening fixed by OS
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus

featureNotes.adBlocker: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite
featureNotes.mv2Support: MV2 removed upstream; Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 Aug 31, 2026
